evaluator: Fictionalized Margaret Morse analytical lens only; this is not Margaret Morse, not a quotation, and not an endorsement.
evidence: The homepage makes the artistic-civic-technical-social through-line discoverable within two clicks through About and the project pages.
Open House is accurately bounded as a 2006 participatory gallery experiment with communal decision-making and distributed documentation, without converting criticism into a testimonial.
WOW List translates social observation into a usable natural-language community platform and separates its July 2017 scale snapshot from its 2026 public return in progress.
196 Artists Residency and Sunday Dinner translate hospitality, care, participation, and place into repeatable invitation, onboarding, hosting, documentation, access-handoff, and follow-up systems.
NYC Artist Coalition and FairRentNYC translate situated cultural-space participation into civic infrastructure while preserving collective policy and campaign credit.

Source-Backed Team Memory carries attention and documentation into a current technical method through Known, Open, and Protected states, correction traces, source-linked decisions, human review, and explicit handoffs.
Case pages provide resolvable source notes, source limitations, dated status language, visibility labels, and Known, Open, and Protected boundaries.
Project roles, collaborators, and evidentiary limits are visible rather than buried.
safety_findings: Participant privacy passes, with participant-level records explicitly withheld.
Collective-credit safeguards distinguish initiation, individual implementation, co-building, co-organizing, coalition contribution, and collective outcomes.
No protected educational records or unapproved testimonials were exposed.
recommendation: PASS. Preserve this composition and its boundaries. The portfolio demonstrates at least five bounded continuities in which experimentation, participation, attention, documentation, care, place, and hospitality become usable systems and transferable handoffs.
